## LUCH — HEA public-experience release gate

**Default status: HOLD. Do not merge because links or builds passed.**

[Creative standard (RU)](../../docs/HEA_CREATIVE_GATE.ru.md) · [EN](../../docs/HEA_CREATIVE_GATE.md) · [Evidence form](../../docs/HEA_REVIEW_PACKET.ru.md)

- Target first-time visitor and human result:
- One completed, verifiable example and exact primary links:
- Why would the visitor want to try?
- Actual first step and current access conditions:
- **Exact commit SHA / preview being evaluated:**

### Non-negotiable reviews
- [ ] Non-author creative critic gave a signed, reasoned verdict on this exact SHA (all six axes)
- [ ] At least 5 genuine uncoached first-time viewers tested the exact render; records linked
- [ ] 4/5 know the benefit, find the first action and independently want to try
- [ ] No misleading examples, account availability claims or third-person founder voice
- [ ] Visual QA at 320/390/768/1440; keyboard, contrast, CTA and locale checked
- [ ] Technical/rollback QA separately completed
- [ ] Founder approved this exact SHA **after** independent review

**Unfilled item = HOLD / NO_GO**, not “mostly PASS”. The author cannot sign as independent reviewer. GitHub branch ruleset enforcement is pending; do not confuse this template with a server-side lock.
